function.arguments: {"observation": "The `channel` was not randomly assigned — the email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers. This means that the `customer_segment` is confounded with `channel`. A raw difference in conversion rates between channels will be biased because loyal customers have higher conversion rates regardless of the channel. Therefore, the raw difference (0.0698) is confounded and does not represent the causal effect of the email campaign.", "implication": "The analysis must adjust for `customer_segment` to isolate the effect of the channel. The correct method is to compute the difference in conversion rates within each `customer_segment`, then combine them using a weighted average (e.g., using the distribution of segments in the email channel as weights). This adjusts for the confounding and provides an unbiased estimate of the campaign's effect."}
function.name: note_finding
